question: A person pays 20% of his monthly salary as monthly payment to repay a loan. He spends 25% of the remaining salary and saves ₹780. Find his monthly salary.
solution:
**Given:**

Loan payment = 20% of salary

He spends 25% of remaining amount

He saves = ₹780

**Formula Used:**

Remaining salary = Salary × (1 − fraction)

Saved amount = Remaining amount after expenses

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let monthly salary = S

⇒ Loan payment = 20% of S = 0.20S

⇒ Remaining salary = S − 0.20S = 0.80S

⇒ He spends 25% of remaining salary = 0.25 × 0.80S = 0.20S

⇒ Amount left after spending = 0.80S − 0.20S

⇒ Amount left = 0.60S

⇒ This remaining amount is 
his savings = 780

⇒ 0.60S = 780

⇒ S = 780 ÷ 0.60

⇒ S = 1300

**∴ His monthly salary is ₹1300.**
